source_refs.note: Importance of IHD: a main subheading of 29.1 Index of Hydrogen Deficiency (IHD), its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 187-188.

blocks.text: Knowing the IHD of a molecule gives clues about its composition and structure. For example, if the IHD is 0, it is certain that the chemical has no rings and no double bonds. This is very helpful because you can find this number easily just by looking at the chemical formula.

blocks.title: Keep in Mind
blocks.text: A double bond and ring each counts as one IHD. A triple bond counts as two IHD.

If the IHD is 1, the chemical must have either one ring or one double bond, but it cannot have both. If the IHD is 2, there are a few choices: it could have two rings, two double bonds, one of each, or one triple bond. Thus, IHD can give us very useful information about a chemical without using complex analytical techniques. Also, before using an analytical technique IHD will help to assess which technique would be better for the compound under study. The IHD for hydrocarbons can be calculated using the data given in Table 29.1.
bold: one ring or one double bond

blocks.caption: Table 29.1 Index of hydrogen deficiency
rows: 2 double bonds or 2 rings or 1 double bond plus 1 ring or 1 triple bond

blocks.prompt:
a) Calculate the IHD for each of the following.
i) C₆H₆
ii) C₆H₁₂
iii) C₄H₄
b) Propose the structure of the above compounds.
blocks.explanation:
i) C₆H₆ (IHD 4): benzene, one ring + three C=C.
ii) C₆H₁₂ (IHD 1): hex-1-ene (one C=C) or cyclohexane (one ring).
iii) C₄H₄ (IHD 3): but-1-en-3-yne, CH₂=CH–C≡CH (one C=C + one triple bond).

blocks.prompt:
c) Hopanes are the waxy solids found in petroleum products as residues after refining the crude oil. A hopane has the formula C₃₀H₆₂,
i) Find its IHD.
ii) Predict whether this compound is saturated or not.
blocks.explanation: Hopanes have the formula C₃₀H₅₂ (see the Book correction below). i) IHD = (2 × 30 + 2 − 52) / 2 = 5. ii) Hopane has five rings and no double bonds, so it is saturated. (The printed formula C₃₀H₆₂ gives IHD = 0: also saturated, but with no rings.)

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: Hopanes are saturated hydrocarbons with five rings and the formula C₃₀H₅₂ (IHD = 5). The printed C₃₀H₆₂ is the formula of an open-chain alkane (IHD = 0).
